QUOTE: "**Detached async-ask worker outlives `stop()`.** `run_async_ask` ends with `.detach()` (`external_bridge.cpp:1222`). The lambda captures `this` and `handle_`. `stop()` joins the accept and client threads but never waits on the detached worker."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names the async-ask worker as detached, notes it outlives `stop()`, and says nothing joins it. It doesn't say outright that it is the only detached thread, but the item's mechanism (detached, outlives scope, no join) is stated.
